name: Longosuchus
sum: Longosuchus is a desmatosuchin aetosaur from the Late Triassic of North America.
holotype: Not stated in the sources consulted for this draft; named as Typothorax meadei by Sawin in 1947 from the Otis Chalk quarries, Howard County, Texas.
material: Skeletal remains from the Otis Chalk quarries of western Texas; reported Moroccan fossils are probably scutes of a paratypothoracin.
biology: The sources consulted describe its taxonomy and size but give no direct evidence of diet or habits.
author: Hunt and Lucas 1990
